title: Chapter 302: Zerg Loses The Election
content:
Chapter 302: Zerg Loses The Election

All the people present are representatives of the strongest middle-class tribes in the local camp. The tribes behind them have strong intelligence capabilities and of course have some understanding of the situation of the Zerg.

The Zerg is a race that the super tribe Goblin tribe personally supports. It is a race that can fight alone against the super tribe of the evil god camp, the alien race, and win the battle. It is impossible not to attract everyone's attention.

The representative of the giant tribe who presided over the meeting seemed to have anticipated this situation. He said to the representative of the goblin tribe: "Then please ask the representative of the goblin tribe to explain the reasons for recommending the Zerg and submit relevant information about the Zerg!"

The information of other candidate races has been submitted and updated to the latest status. Each tribe can check these materials.

The strength assessment of each candidate race, the performance of various aspects, and other information have been sorted out and summarized for reference by the major tribes.

Each tribe present will decide which race to choose to obtain the status of a tribe by checking these materials, combining the intelligence obtained by the tribe and subjective evaluation.

The selection of new tribes is a very complicated matter, involving too many factors.

From the original intention, of course, we have to select the strongest race in the local camp. Only the strongest race is qualified to obtain the status of a great clan.

The great clan represents not only rights and interests, but more importantly, responsibilities.

Choosing a weak race is not only unfair, but also damages the interests of the local camp, everyone's interests, and the interests of the selected person.

Therefore, everyone has no objection to selecting the strongest race.

Only when the conditions of multiple races are almost the same and the number of great clans is limited, various transactions and means will prevail.

The situation of this selection is more complicated. There are many recommended races and many races that meet the conditions, but there are only five great clans this time, and various private interest exchanges have already begun.

Now a Zerg suddenly appeared, making the situation more complicated.

The representative of the Goblin clan handed the Zerg-related information that had been prepared long ago to the staff.

"I need to waste a little time for everyone. Let me briefly explain why my Goblin clan and the Naga clan jointly recommend the Zerg!"

The representative of the Goblin clan continued.

"The main reason why we recommend the Zerg is the same as the reason why everyone recommends other races, all because of strength!"

"The Zerg has a powerful person in charge, and this alone makes it stronger than most races!"

"The Zerg is extremely powerful. It can be said that it is a fighting race. It focuses on evolving itself and has formed a variety of powerful arms through different evolutionary routes!"

"Each Zerg arm is the best among its kind. I won't introduce the characteristics of each arm. You can check the information!"

"The Zerg has also developed a unique biotechnology system and created some very magical products!"

"Since entering the world, the Zerg has ignored the influence of the forbidden land in a short period of time and established a territory in the forbidden land!"

"It assisted the Naga tribe in defeating the Skeleton Tribe, fought alone against the super tribe, the Alien Race, and is about to successfully open up a new battlefield with the Naga tribe!"

"The Zerg also sent troops to the territories of various races in the native camp. The knights who inherited the skills have cultivated a large number of high-quality soldiers!"

"These achievements of the Zerg were all achieved in a very short time!"

"So, the second reason we recommend the Zerg is because of its potential!"

"The Zerg has the ability to sacrifice enemies on the battlefield, upgrade its troops at any time on the battlefield, and has a variety of rule-level means. They have developed from the ordinary state when they first entered the world to the current strength comparable to that of the big clans in less than a year. To be precise, it should be only a few months!"

"Now the Zerg is in a period of rapid development. Its strength is no weaker than that of ordinary big clans. If it continues to develop, it may soon be able to obtain the status of a super big clan!"

"The emergence of such a powerful race is a good opportunity for our local camp, so we must seize it!"

"We sincerely hope that everyone can choose the Zerg and add another giant to our local camp!"

The representative of the Goblin clan did not make a long speech, but only mentioned the strength and potential of the Zerg.

Objective evaluation, just say this, say too much, it may be counterproductive.

The races that really care about it will read the detailed information, and the races that only care about the benefits of trading will not listen to it no matter how much they say.

After listening to the explanation of the representatives of the goblin tribe, the representatives present began to look through the information about the Zerg that had just been handed to them.

The representatives present had a clear idea of the other candidate races, and they had already decided who to choose in their tribe.

Now that the Zerg has become a variable, some races will not be affected by their own reasons. They just looked through the information of the Zerg and put it down.

The representatives of most races have carefully read the information of the Zerg, and many representatives of races have contacted their tribes to ask for their opinions.

After some time, everyone sat down again, and the selection of the ownership of the status of the local camp’s major races officially began.

Each major race representative selected five candidate races, and finally counted the selection results and selected the five candidate races with the highest number of votes.

The last five races were selected, and as expected, the Zerg was not selected.

The Naga representative exchanged glances with the Goblin representative. The Goblin representative sighed and said, "The Goblins are using the super clan's right to appeal!"

When the representative of the Goblin tribe spoke, everyone was very surprised. They didn't expect the Goblin tribe to support the Zerg to such an extent.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

The right of appeal of the super clan is a special right of the super clan. When various resolutions of the local camp need to be voted by all, the super clan can use the right of appeal and apply for a chance to speak if they are not satisfied with the results.

If they can convince everyone, they can restart the vote or selection.

The status of the super clan is high. When they use the right of appeal to express dissatisfaction, all races, including other super clans, will generally give face.

But when the interests are too great, it is possible that many races will not give face. Many clans that form gangs are not afraid of offending the super clan.

With such a complicated relationship, the super clan rarely uses the right of appeal, which can easily make everyone embarrassed.

The Goblin tribe used the right of appeal of the super clan here, and the atmosphere on the field became strange.

The representative of the Goblin tribe stood up and used the right of appeal, and he was about to speak.

"Our tribe has always acted in an open and aboveboard manner, and we are only dedicated to expelling the invasion of the evil gods, and we have never had any selfish motives!"

"Our tribe highly recognizes the five selected races, but in line with the principle of being responsible for the development of the camp, our tribe believes that the Zerg is more suitable to obtain the status of a major tribe as soon as possible. The joining of the Zerg is extremely beneficial to solving our current dilemma!"

"I bet that half of our races are not as strong as the current Zerg. If the Zerg becomes a major tribe, you can imagine how much their strength can be improved!"

"I hope everyone will think twice before acting, and not lose the major interests of the camp for the sake of the petty interests of the race!"

The representatives of the goblin tribe said these words very seriously, and some representatives of the major tribes looked dissatisfied after hearing them.

But most representatives were still thinking about it.

The prestige of the goblin tribe in the local camp is very high. Now that such harsh words are said, some representatives have to take it seriously even if they are dissatisfied.

The scene was silent for a while, and many representatives began to contact the tribe to explain the situation and solicit opinions.

After a long time, the representatives of most races still did not get a definite response from the tribe, and the situation was deadlocked for a while.

The results of each selection of the status of the great tribe are the result of long-term struggles and transactions, and cannot be changed by a few simple words from the goblins.

Everyone is considering the gains and losses.

How strong are the Zerg? What consequences will different choices face? Is the interests of the race more important or the interests of the camp more important?

These are not things that can be decided in a short time.

Races are not a one-man show. Many major things require constant discussions within the tribe before the results can be drawn.

This is also because the timing of the Zerg's appearance is wrong. If they enter the world earlier, the goblins and Naga will have more time to prepare, and the situation may not be so embarrassing.

The goblins are working so hard to fight for the status of the great tribe for the Zerg. There is a little selfishness, but more of it is indeed out of the justice of the camp.

The goblins are really optimistic about the development of the Zerg through a series of performances of the Zerg.

The high-level officials of the goblins have discussed that with the characteristics of the Zerg becoming stronger with each battle, as long as the public battlefield in the southern war zone is played, the goblins will be afraid of the Zerg.

Moreover, the Zerg developed in multiple directions at the same time, and the cooperation with the Naga tribe also achieved amazing results.

As long as the Zerg obtains the status of a large tribe and then the status of a super large tribe, the decline of the local camp will be reversed.

The scene was a bit awkward. The representative of the super large tribe, the human race, who had been silent, a handsome middle-aged human man, smiled and said: "Everyone, listen to me!"

The representatives of the major tribes saw that the super large tribe of human race was willing to speak out, which was exactly what they wanted, and they instantly quieted down.

"We all know that the selection of new great tribes requires long-term inspection and evaluation. Everyone has heard of the power of the Zerg, but I guess they are not familiar with it!"

"It is understandable that the various tribes cannot make a final decision on the appeal of the Goblin tribe in a short period of time!"

"I have an idea, let me share it with you for your reference, let's see how it goes!"

"In addition to the ordinary quotas generated each time, there is also a special quota for the great tribe status that has been ignored by everyone!"

"The special quota for the great tribe status is an incomplete quota. The race that obtains the special quota needs to plunder the enemy's camp luck alone to grow into a real great tribe!"

"It is very difficult to obtain the great tribe status through special quotas. It is said that in ancient times, all races were proud to obtain the great tribe status in this way!"
